name: List shipments
description: OPEN DESIGN QUESTION — not a working bulk shipment sync. GET /2026-07/shipment/{shipmentId} returns one shipment and requires shipmentId. API 2026-07 has no bulk GET /shipment list (the retired /1.0/shipment list path is not on the current documented surface). Shipment data is nested on GET /2026-07/order as shipments[] on each order. CatalogRuntimeConnector sync_plan only supports a single dotted records_path into one response (for example "items" or "artists.items") and has no precedent for flattening an array inside every element of another array. Bulk shipment sync needs a framework decision from Nate / the connector platform owner before this entity can be considered fixed: either add multi-path records_path flattening to CatalogRuntimeConnector, or stop syncing shipments as its own entity and surface shipments[] as a nested field on orders. Do not treat this action as resolved.

shipmentId.description: Required path id. There is no bulk-list query (no Page/Limit) on GET /2026-07/shipment/{shipmentId}.
